Request Body Params: pipeline_name (string, required, 1-120 chars); config (object, optional, default: auto-picked OpenAI config if OPENAI_API_KEY is set else Ollama config, applied to all 7 agents -- see AgentModelConfig fields below); initial_requirements (object, optional, default {}) -- a requirements_patch applied immediately (source/sink/schema/joins/scale/validation/naming_style/notes/open_questions, all freeform). config.<agent> (planner/connect/ksqldb/evaluator/edge_case/executor/debug) each has: provider ("openai"|"ollama", default "ollama"), model (string), temperature (float 0-2, default 0.0), max_tokens (int >=128, default 4096). config.kafka_bootstrap_servers / config.connect_url / config.ksqldb_url (string, optional, default null).
Success Response: SessionState: session_id (string), pipeline_name (string), config (SessionConfig), whiteboard (Whiteboard, all fields empty/defaulted), messages ([], empty), status ("requirements"), pending_approval (null), created_at, updated_at (ISO8601).

Description: List sessions, most recently updated first.
Send a chat message to the Planner; runs the full Planner/Worker dispatch loop for this turn and returns once it lands on a user-facing stopping point (needs input, awaiting approval, or done).
Request Body Params: message (string, required, 1-20000 chars); artifact_id (string, optional, default null -- scopes this message to one proposed artifact via the Pipeline Graph "revise this one" flow).
Success Response: SessionMessageResponse: { session: SessionState (updated), reply: string (Planner's reply_to_user for this turn), tasks: [] (reserved, currently always empty) }

Description: Approve or reject the whole pending phase of proposed artifacts (all artifacts sharing the current pending_approval phase).
Request Body Params: approved (bool, required); comment (string, optional, max 5000 chars, default null -- used as the revision request if rejected).
Success Response: SessionMessageResponse (same shape as POST /message). Errors: 409 Conflict if no approval is currently pending.

Description: Build a deployment package for the committed pipeline, and optionally apply it live (POST connector configs / run ksqlDB statements against the configured environment).
Request Body Params: mode (string enum "package"|"apply", optional, default "package" -- "package" only builds the deployable bundle; "apply" also executes it against config.connect_url/ksqldb_url).
Success Response: SessionState (updated whiteboard.deployment_status: state/package_path/records/error). Errors: 409 Conflict if session.status is not "ready" or "deployed".

Description: Fetch the full current state of a session.
Success Response: SessionState (see POST /sessions). Errors: 404 Not Found if session_id doesn't exist.

Description: Fetch just the whiteboard portion of a session (requirements/plan/artifacts/evaluation/notes), without the rest of SessionState.
Success Response: Whiteboard: requirements, plan, topics, connectors, ksqldb_objects, artifacts ([Artifact]), evaluation, decisions, deployment_status, pipeline_notes (string), revision (int), updated_at.

Description: Fetch the Pipeline Graph view: nodes for every source/sink connector, topic, and ksqlDB stream/table, plus edges between them, with live Kafka Connect status merged onto connector nodes. Meant to be polled periodically (every ~30s) by the frontend so connector colors reflect live run state.
Success Response: PipelineGraph: { nodes: [PipelineGraphNode, ...], edges: [PipelineGraphEdge, ...] }. PipelineGraphNode: id (string, e.g. "connector:orders-source" / "topic:orders.orders" / "ksql:ORDERS_STREAM"), name (string), type ("source_connector"|"sink_connector"|"topic"|"ksql_stream"|"ksql_table"), artifact_id (string|null), phase (connector: "source"|"sink"; ksqlDB: "raw"|"aggregate"|"join"; topic: null), status ("proposed"|"committed"|null for topics), statement (ksqlDB CREATE statement, null for non-ksqlDB nodes), connector_status (null for non-connector nodes; else {color: "green"|"red"|"orange"|"grey", state: raw Connect state or null, failed_tasks (int), total_tasks (int), detail (string|null, set when the live lookup itself failed or session isn't deployed yet)}). PipelineGraphEdge: { source: node id, target: node id }.

Description: Fetch the raw event/activity log for a session (session/user_message/agent_message/task/approval/deployment/error) -- used by the frontend to drive the pipeline graph and task history, not the chat box.
Query Params: after (datetime ISO8601, optional, default null -- only events strictly after this timestamp); limit (int, optional, default 100, 1-1000)
Success Response: EventList: { events: [SessionEvent, ...], next_cursor: datetime|null (created_at of the last returned event, for pagination) }

Description: Fetch the human<->planner chat history for a session (never agent-to-agent traffic) -- what the chat box renders. Stored directly on the session document; auto-backfills once from the legacy events log for sessions created before this storage change, so old chat isn't lost.
Success Response: ChatMessageList: { messages: [ChatMessage, ...] } in chronological order. Each ChatMessage: message_id, session_id, role ("user"|"assistant"), content (string), starred (bool), metadata (object, e.g. {source, artifact_id, artifact_name}), created_at.

Description: Send a chat message via the Planner -- identical behavior to POST /message, offered as a chat-UI-friendly alias under the same path prefix as GET /chat-messages.
Request Body Params: message (string, required, 1-20000 chars); artifact_id (string, optional, default null).

Description: Star or unstar a chat message, so it always stays in the Planner's context regardless of the last-10 window.
Success Response: ChatMessage (the updated message). Errors: 404 Not Found if message_id doesn't exist in this session.

Description: Approve or reject exactly one proposed artifact, independent of the rest of its phase (used by the Pipeline Graph's per-node approve/reject).
Request Body Params: approved (bool, required); comment (string, optional, max 5000 chars, default null -- used as the revision request if rejected and it was the last artifact in the phase to resolve).
Success Response: SessionMessageResponse (same shape as POST /message; reply may be empty if other artifacts in the same phase are still pending). Errors: 404 Not Found if artifact_id doesn't exist; 409 Conflict if the artifact isn't currently "proposed".
